summary.text: Douglas Everett is the Republican candidate for Arizona State Senate District 18 in the November 3, 2026 general election, running against incumbent Democrat Priya Sundareshan.
In a Ballotpedia survey, he described himself as a retired electrical engineer who worked 37 years in the aerospace industry.

paragraphs.text: Douglas Everett earned a high school diploma from Arlington High School and a bachelor's degree from Texas A&M University in 1986.
His career experience includes working as an electrical engineer.

In a Ballotpedia survey, he said he has served as a youth chess club coach, Boy Scout leader, merit badge counselor and Big Brothers mentor, and is a Knights of Columbus Deputy Grand Knight at his church.

Everett named jobs, opportunities and safety as his main themes, including support for dependable energy, water management, eliminating regulations he considers meaningless, and preserving funding choices for families in education.
